task: Make SeaweedFS filer/master and the NFS directory layout ready for a root_squash export (narwhal#224): non-root SeaweedFS, align script, runbook procedure

events.summary: Repo-only change. No live Kakao cluster, export, or ownership was changed. The input inventory (.omc/logs/f2-report.md) was an unverified Gemini lane; image uid, chart keys, and Vagrant layout were re-derived from the pinned image, the bundled chart and the repo scripts.

chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.34 has user seaweed 1000:1000 (docker run --entrypoint cat /etc/passwd) and an entrypoint that su-execs to it, but the chart's command runs /usr/bin/weed directly, so the pods run as the image USER (root). Chart 4.34.0 master/filer log volumes render as root-owned hostPath, which uid 1000 cannot write; fsGroup is inert on nfs.csi.k8s.io.

master/filer podSecurityContext 1000/1000 + fsGroup OnRootMismatch and logs emptyDir in the GitOps chart and 08-4 helm flags; scripts/cluster/nfs-root-squash-align.sh (dry-run default, --apply, running-consumer guard, never edits exports); runbook procedure; R267, R268; lessons-log row.

events.scope: helm template of the bundled seaweedfs 4.34.0 chart with the Application valuesObject, before versus after
events.summary: Diff shows only the securityContext on the master and filer StatefulSets and their log volumes becoming emptyDir; volume and s3 unchanged. The align script was run in a root debian container against fake kubectl output: dry run changed nothing, --apply chowned root-owned entries to 1000:1000 / 1000:2000, namespace dirs to nobody:nogroup, share root to nobody:nogroup 750, and a second --apply planned nothing.

events.scope: Repo static suite and lint with the change; no cluster
events.summary: make test: 394 passed, 0 failed, 3 warnings (R267, R268 PASS; R267 fails when the filer runAsUser is mutated); make validate OK; shellcheck --severity=warning clean on the changed scripts.

Static and container-level behavior verified. Not verified: non-root SeaweedFS against real data on the live cluster, the live file inventory, CSIDriver fsGroupPolicy and timer state on Kakao, and the export switch itself.
Repo change verified statically and in a root container; live alignment and export switch pending per the runbook and unverified (e6).
